notes: Durations, radii, and tolerances are implementation tuning, not additional design rules. Skill space is normalized 0-1, origin top-left, for presentation overlays.

phases.name: Shape Trace
phases.description: Touch every club-shaped checkpoint in any order, then left-click to complete within the time limit. Missed checkpoints can be revisited. Leaving the outline has no penalty.

phases.name: Shard Fit
phases.description: Move the angular cursor symbol over the matching recess and left-click when automatic rotation aligns. Wrong clicks continue with remaining time. Expiration fails quietly.
